javascript.title: Inheritance
javascript.description: Inheritance lets one class reuse behavior from another class.
javascript.content: Inheritance creates a parent-child relationship between classes to share logic.

javascript.title: Abstraction
javascript.description: Abstraction hides implementation details behind simple interfaces.
javascript.content: Abstraction focuses on what an object does rather than how it does it.

javascript.title: Polymorphism
javascript.description: Polymorphism allows the same method to behave differently by type.
javascript.content: Polymorphism enables interchangeable objects through shared interfaces.
